title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Event Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2606.15917v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a recently devised sample and memory efficient reinforcement learning method, to finetune pretrained LLMs in the range of 1.5B to 14B parameters equipped with the ability to get current information through the use of a Wikipedia revisions tool, or news summaries, to forecast real events beyond the knowledge cutoff of the LLM, as well as problems made to simulate different aspects of the dynamics of that training.   We use the results of these experiments to comment on the scaling capability of LLMs for forecasting, as well as classify how judgmental forecasting fits into the verifiable/unverifiable domain taxonomy, considering the impact of the inherent aleatoric uncertainty when forecasting future events (e.g. the roll of a die).   As a result of the GRPO training, we manage to bring a 1.5B parameter transformer (Qwen 2.5 1.5B) to forecasting performance superior to Claude Sonnet 3.5

translated_title: 基于强化学习的大语言模型事件预测
translated_abstract: 我们使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）——一种近期提出的节省样本和内存的强化学习方法——来微调参数规模在1.5B到14B之间的预训练大语言模型，使其具备通过维基百科修订工具或新闻摘要获取当前信息的能力，从而预测超出大语言模型知识截止日期的真实事件，同时我们还设计了用于模拟该训练动态不同方面的问题。我们利用这些实验结果来评述大语言模型在预测任务上的扩展能力，并将判断性预测归类到可验证/不可验证的领域分类体系中，同时考虑预测未来事件（例如掷骰子）时固有的偶然不确定性所产生的影响。通过GRPO训练，我们成功使一个1.5B参数的Transformer模型（Qwen 2.5 1.5B）在预测性能上超越了Claude Sonnet 3.5。
tldr: 该论文利用GRPO强化学习方法微调配备维基百科和新闻检索工具的大语言模型来预测超出其知识截止日期的真实事件，最终使仅1.5B参数的Qwen 2.5模型在预测性能上超越了Claude Sonnet 3.5。
en_tdlr: This paper finetunes LLMs equipped with Wikipedia and news retrieval tools using GRPO reinforcement learning to forecast real events beyond the models' knowledge cutoff, enabling a 1.5B-parameter Qwen 2.5 model to surpass Claude Sonnet 3.5 in forecasting performance.
